testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.common.HardeningTests

testcase.name: API responses carry restrictive security headers and the CSRF cookie is SameSite()
auth config tells the UI which sign-in options exist and metrics are not readable by sessions()
prod profile fails fast when required variables are missing()
access logs never contain query strings, ids or credentials()
oversized JSON bodies are rejected with 413 before any processing()
